title: [Cobblemon] CobbleLegends

body:
CobbleLegends is a brand new, non-pay-to-win, community-focused Cobblemon server. It offers a wide range of exclusive features, including all Megas, raids, a Battle Tower, hunts, and Dex rewards.

We provide a variety of content and host fun weekly events. Starting on Fridays with 5x shiny rates, followed by a scheduled community event on Saturdays, and a legendary raid every Sunday.

We also have Guilds, allowing you to team up with friends or meet new ones and compete to become the top guild on the server. Alongside this, we have a unique economy with player-run shops and custom warps.

We will also be hosting monthly prize pool tournaments, starting with our first event at the end of March featuring a $100 prize pool. Join now to get a head start and compete to become the champion.
